name: Industriousness
overview: Scripture teaches that industriousness is a reflection of wisdom and faithfulness, as seen in the call to observe the ant's diligent ways and to be wise (Proverbs 6:6). Believers are encouraged to work wholeheartedly as unto the Lord, not men, demonstrating faithfulness in all tasks which leads to greater responsibilities and joy (Colossians 3:23; Matthew 25:21). This diligent effort is empowered by Christ's strength (Philippians 4:13) and is expressed through maintaining good works and honest trades for necessary needs (Titus 3:14), all grounded in the motivation of God's love revealed through Christ (John 3:16).
